tasks.title: Debut
objectives: Eliminate 5 Scavs on Customs
Find 2 MP‑133 12ga shotguns in raid
Hand over 2 MP‑133 12ga shotguns
tasks.description: Prapor wants you to thin out the scav population on Customs and collect a couple of MP‑133 shotguns to show your dedication.

tasks.title: Checking
objectives: Obtain the bronze pocket watch on a chain on Customs
Survive and extract from the location
Hand over the watch to Prapor
tasks.description: Recover Prapor's bronze pocket watch from a truck at Customs. You'll need the Machinery key to access it.
tasks.rewards: PP‑91 Kedr submachine gun and supplies

tasks.title: Shortage
objectives: Find 3 Salewa first aid kits in raid
Hand over 3 Salewa first aid kits
tasks.description: The Therapist's clinic is running low on first aid kits. She needs you to bring her Salewa kits as soon as possible.

tasks.title: Operation Aquarius – Part 1
objectives: Locate the water hidden inside Dorm Room 206 on Customs
Survive and extract from Customs
Hand over the water to Therapist
tasks.description: Gain access to Dorm Room 206 on Customs and retrieve the bottled water left there by Therapist's helpers.

tasks.title: General Wares
objectives: Find 2 Can of beef stew (Large) in raid
Find 2 Bottles of water (0.6L) in raid
Hand over the items to Therapist
tasks.description: The Therapist is looking to stock up on some basic supplies. Bring her beef stew and water found in raid.

tasks.title: Supplier
objectives: Find 7.62×39mm 30‑round magazine for AK and hand over
Find Tushonka in raid and hand over 4 cans
tasks.description: Skier wants to check if you can deliver some basic goods. Get him a few 7.62 AK magazines and cans of tushonka.

tasks.title: The Extortionist
objectives: Find the hidden valuable cargo on Customs
Obtain the documents in the bunkhouse
Hand over the valuable cargo and the documents
tasks.description: Recover a valuable jacket with documents hidden in a stash at Customs. Watch out for other players!

tasks.title: Gunsmith – Part 1
objectives: Modify an MP‑133 to comply with the required specifications
tasks.description: Mechanic has given you your first gunsmithing task: modify an MP‑133 shotgun so that it meets a list of ergonomic and part requirements.

tasks.title: Gunsmith – Part 2
objectives: Modify an AKS‑74U to comply with the required specifications
tasks.description: Continuing the gunsmith series, Mechanic asks you to tune an AKS‑74U with better ergonomics, recoil control, and compactness.

tasks.title: Fishing Gear
objectives: Mark the first boat with an MS2000 marker
Mark the second boat with an MS2000 marker
Survive and extract from Shoreline
tasks.description: Peacekeeper needs intel on boats used by scav smugglers on Shoreline. Plant markers on the boats and make it out alive.
